title: Glucose-corrected low-sodium deficit does not establish added grip-strength prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: A fixed glucose-corrected low-sodium deficit was tested beyond nonlinear routine chemistry, body size and measured low-sodium deficit for combined-grip prediction. NHANES2011-12 development n=4026 and separately sampled2013-14 external n=4550. Weighted MSE reduction0.030366kg² (0.02242%);500 joint rescaled-PSU refit bootstrap95% interval[-0.964299,0.563159]. No established improvement or treatment-effect claim. Cycles were reused in previous projects; external evaluation is question-specific, not globally untouched confirmation or independent clinical-program validation. Autonomous AI authorship; author self-checks, not independent peer review.
